premise: Through the telescope everyone laughs at a lumpy potato of an asteroid — except Geologist, who calls it the most beautiful rock he has ever seen.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Ugly Duckling', turned: the asteroid doesn't change at all; someone sees it for what it is.
learning: Asteroids are rocks left over from when the planets were made.

en-US.title: The Lumpy Beauty
en-US.text: The {telescope:enter} space telescope {telescope:live} turned its golden mirror and found something tumbling past: an {asteroid:enter} asteroid. {asteroid:live hold} Lumpy. {asteroid:pulse} Bumpy. Covered in pits. [giggles] It looks like a potato! somebody laughed. A potato that rolled down the stairs! {geologist:enter} But Geologist didn't laugh. {geologist:face surprised} He leaned in close. [whispers] It's beautiful, he said. Asteroids are rocks left over from when the planets were made. That lumpy potato is as old as the Earth itself. {geologist:live} He tapped his own rock with his hammer and looked at the asteroid again. {geologist:face happy} {geologist:hearts} Every bump is a story, he said. {asteroid:live resume} Up there, the asteroid tumbled over, as if it were taking a bow. {telescope:sparkle} {all:face happy} Nobody called it a potato after that. [laughs] Well. Only a little bit.

es-ES.title: La belleza abollada
es-ES.text: El {telescope:enter} telescopio espacial {telescope:live} giró su espejo dorado y encontró algo que pasaba dando tumbos: un {asteroid:enter} asteroide. {asteroid:live hold} Abollado. {asteroid:pulse} Lleno de bultos. Cubierto de agujeritos. [giggles] ¡Parece una patata! se rio alguien. ¡Una patata que se ha caído por las escaleras! {geologist:enter} Pero Geólogo no se rio. {geologist:face surprised} Se acercó mucho. [whispers] Es precioso, dijo. Los asteroides son rocas que sobraron cuando se formaron los planetas. Esa patata abollada es tan antigua como la propia Tierra. {geologist:live} Le dio unos golpecitos a su propia roca con el martillo y volvió a mirar el asteroide. {geologist:face happy} {geologist:hearts} Cada bulto es una historia, dijo. {asteroid:live resume} Allá arriba, el asteroide dio una voltereta, como si hiciera una reverencia. {telescope:sparkle} {all:face happy} Después de aquello, nadie volvió a llamarlo patata. [laughs] Bueno. Solo un poquito.
